race.comment: DARK ARTS (15) has proven frustrating for his supporters but clearly has his share of ability. If KWT can settle him closer and get him clear at the right time, he will take a power of stopping. GRAMMAR LAD (11) trialled strongly before his return two weeks ago but found himself too far back on a day when it was hard to make ground, but he did manage to make some inroads. Expect them to be more positive second-up and if so he can win. WOOTTEN HYDE (17) was a smart winner first-up but couldn't quite repeat the dose second-up when leaving himself with too much ground to bridge. Daresay he will suffer the same fate here but he does look a handy type, so not writing him off. BAT OUT OF HELL (2) has put two on the bounce from a short break, and while he's drawn awful he deserves respect.
